newsitem.title: CANADA: Marleau Lemire hits new high on bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Marleau Lemire hits new high on bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Marleau Lemire Inc jumped on Monday after the independent Canadian investment dealer said it had been approached by a potential buyer.
Marleau's stock rose 0.30 to 7.60, a 52-week high, on 23,500 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange after trading resumed at 1315 EDT.
The stock gained 0.10 to 7.60 on the Montreal Exchange.
The stock was halted earlier for the company's announcement that it had been approached by an interested third party.
"Discussions are at a preliminary stage and there can be no assurance that any transaction will be concluded," the Montreal-based company said in a statement.
Marleau Lemire said its board of directors has set up an independent committee to consider the matter.
